contact-center-sdk.summary: Published npm package @webex/contact-center. main and exports[.] are dist/webex.js (src/webex.js); types is dist/types/index.d.ts built from src/index.ts, which exports ContactCenter (src/cc.ts, registered as webex.cc), routingAgent, Task, AddressBook, ApiAIAssistant, UserPreference, getDefaultUIControls, the event enums, and the public types. Specified in src/docs/README.md.

contact-center-cc-events.summary: CC_EVENTS, CC_AGENT_EVENTS, CC_TASK_EVENTS and VOICE_CONNECTION_EVENTS: the WebSocket notification types and the SDK events ContactCenter emits for them. Specified in src/services/config/docs/README.md.

contact-center-agent-events.summary: AGENT_EVENTS and the agent request and response types for station login, logout, state change, buddy agents, and relogin. Specified in src/services/agent/docs/README.md.

contact-center-task-events.summary: TASK_EVENTS and the TaskData, TaskResponse, and task method payload types emitted and accepted by Task, Voice, WebRTC, and Digital. Specified in src/services/task/docs/README.md.

contact-center-task-state-machine.summary: XState task state machine factory, TaskState and TaskEvent contracts, guards, actions, and the UI-control computer; getDefaultUIControls is re-exported publicly through src/index.ts. Specified in src/services/task/state-machine/docs/README.md.

contact-center-services.summary: Services composition root that builds the agent, config, contact, and dialer request factories over AqmReqs and WebexRequest. Specified in src/services/docs/README.md.

contact-center-core-transport.summary: AqmReqs request/notification correlation, WebexRequest HTTP calls, WebSocketManager and ConnectionService socket lifecycle, and the shared error and utility helpers. Specified in src/services/core/docs/README.md.

contact-center-metrics.summary: METRIC_EVENT_NAMES and the MetricsManager behavioral, operational, and business event submission API. Specified in src/metrics/docs/README.md.

contact-center-page-cache.summary: PageCache and the pagination types and defaults shared by AddressBook, EntryPoint, and Queue. Specified in src/utils/docs/README.md.

wxcc-api-gateway.source: Webex Contact Center API gateway (WCC API), reached through webex.request with the wcc-api-gateway service name
wxcc-api-gateway.summary: Agent, task, configuration, address book, entry point, queue, user preference, and AI assistant REST endpoints owned by the Contact Center backend. This package consumes them and owns no route.

wxcc-websocket-notifications.source: Webex Contact Center notification WebSocket (subscribe endpoint and socket messages)
wxcc-websocket-notifications.summary: Agent, task, and configuration notifications pushed by the Contact Center backend and correlated by AqmReqs; message type names are mirrored in src/services/config/types.ts.

webex-core-plugin-runtime.summary: registerPlugin, WebexPlugin, webex.request service routing, and the ready lifecycle the ContactCenter plugin is built on.

webex-calling-sdk.summary: Calling client, line registration, and call objects used for BROWSER station login and WebRTC voice tasks.

webex-internal-mercury.summary: Mercury event stream used for the Webex app (Better Together) telephony synchronisation.

webex-internal-metrics.summary: Internal metrics submission used by MetricsManager.

webex-internal-support.summary: Log upload used by the uploadLogs flow.

xstate-runtime.summary: Actor and state-machine runtime behind the task state machine.

module_docs_decision.reason: The nine modules confirmed in the 2026-07-07 onboarding keep their paths. Their older source-local ai-docs specs move to the repo-standards default <module>/docs/README.md. test:style lints only src/**/*.ts and build:src compiles only -js -ts, so Markdown under src/ does not reach lint or dist.

repo_context_decision.reason: Neither the operational context nor its schema existed in this package. The context is created from package evidence and the migrated glossary; the schema is copied from the repository-root .sdd/templates/repo-standards/schemas/repo-context.schema.json.

artifact_decisions.reason: Library package, not a deployable service. package.json has no start script, container, or deployment descriptor.
No package-level documentation site exists. build:docs writes typedoc output to the workspace docs/wxcc folder.
The package serves no HTTP routes. It consumes the Contact Center API gateway (wxcc-api-gateway, external); its published surface is the npm export described by contact-center-sdk.
Security policy is owned at the webex-js-sdk repository root; security architecture is described in docs/architecture.md.
Contribution guidance is owned at the webex-js-sdk repository root.
The monorepo generates changelogs centrally through its release tooling.
No CTO checklist process applies to this package.

consumed: the workspace root ../../../.eslintrc.js (airbnb-base plus eslintrules), which test:style resolves; the package has no .eslintrc.js of its own
@webex/legacy-tools build and test runner via package.json
workspace tsconfig.json via the package tsconfig.json
Repo Standards templates at the monorepo root .sdd/templates/repo-standards, referred to through layout.monorepo_package.templates_root_path (this package holds no templates)
